## RYANAIR REVEALS FIRST 29 NEW ROUTES FOR SUMMER 2027 AHEAD OF BUMPER SUMMER 2027 SCHEDULE LAUNCH


**GIVING CUSTOMERS THE CHANCE TO BOOK EARLY AND AVAIL OF THE LOWEST FARES**


Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (Fri, 9 Oct) launched the first new routes of its Summer 2027 schedule, giving cost-savvy customers the chance to get ahead of the flock and bag themselves a bargain early bird fare. Ryanair is set to operate a bumper schedule in Summer 2027, with over 2,500 routes across the airline’s industry leading network of 230 destinations, delivering unbeatable choice and reliability to its more than 214 million customers p.a. across Europe.


Ryanair’s first 29 new Summer 2027 routes are available to book now on Ryanair’s app/website. As demand for summer travel builds over the coming months, customers looking to secure the lowest fares should book now before fares inevitably go up.


Ryanair CMO, Dara Brady, said:


“Ryanair is pleased to launch the first 29 new routes of what is set to be a bumper Summer 2027 schedule, giving our cost-savvy customers an early opportunity to start planning next year’s getaways. These are the first of our new Summer 2027 routes to go on sale, with more exciting additions to be announced as Ryanair continues to expand Europe’s largest route network. Customers looking to secure the lowest fares for their Summer 2027 travel should head to the Ryanair app/website and book now to get ahead of the curve.”

## [RYANAIR LAUNCHES PRAGUE – PAPHOS & KOSICE ROUTES](https://dev-corporate.fr164-0.ryanair.com/news/ryanair-launches-prague-paphos-kosice-routes/)


Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (1st August) celebrated the first flight from Prague to Paphos, while on Monday (3rd August) it will launch a twice weekly service to Kosice, both as part of its extended Summer 2020 schedule.


To celebrate its new routes, Ryanair has launched a seat sale with fares from 729 Kc for travel to Kosice and from 759 Kc to Paphos, both until the end of October, which must be booked by Wednesday (5th August), only on the Ryanair.com website.
